en: Miri: So this is the ruin that\nreproduces memories...

It's a lot plainer than I
imagined. I thought there'd be
rows and rows of machines I'd
never seen before.
Let's keep moving forward.\nMiri-tan, Ted-tan, <player>-tan.

Miri: I'm just afraid of what
might happen if a painful past
is reproduced. Lati said it
showed the moment Dorne
collapsed...

And when Fidel came back
from here, he looked pale as a
ghost, muttering something
about "fish guts..."
Miri: Aren't you scared, Lymle?\nDon't you have a past you'd\nrather forget too?
Even the painful things are an\nimportant part of who I am.
Huh?
I couldn't... save them...
I'm... sorry...
Sad memories are precious\ntoo. Everything leads to who I\nam now.
Miri: Lymle...
That's... right! Because of the\npast, we are who we are today!

Yeah! Even the parts of the
past I want to look away from
are still a part of me. Alright,
let's go!
What?!
I won't have to hear your lip for\na while.
Gonna miss me?
I'll be relieved.
That's cold, hahaha!
Come back safe.
I'll make it back in time. Until\nthen, I'm counting on you to\nlook after everyone in Sthal.
Consider it done.

This is the memory of when
Fidel left for the Royal Capital
to protect the village from
bandits.
Come to think of it, that's\nwhere their adventure truly\nbegan.
It looks like there's more to it.
Alright, I'm off.
Yeah.
Ted, you look absolutely\nmiserable.
Meryl... What about the clinic?\nThere must be so many injured\nfrom yesterday's attack.

Meryl: Everyone is past the
critical point. From here on, all
a doctor can do is monitor
their natural healing and wait
for them to recover slowly.

Meryl: Right now, I simply
wanted to see the back of the
hero as he sets off to save
this village.
Meryl: ...He looks just like his\nfather.

Meryl: Are you anxious?
Wondering if you can protect
this village from Eitalon while
Fidel is gone?

N-no way! The only reason the
village survived last night was
thanks to me! If anything, I'm
worried about Fidel―he can be
surprisingly clueless!
Meryl: Hehe, I see. I shouldn't\nhave compared you to me, Ted.
Compare me to you, Ms.\nMeryl?

Meryl: When my childhood
friend Daril left this village, I
had the same look on my face
that you do now.

Man, I'm pathetic... thinking
about myself while he's the one
heading out on a dangerous
journey.

But once I started wondering if
I could actually protect
everyone if the village was
attacked while he was gone, I
just couldn't stop.
Meryl: After the commotion\nlast night, it's only natural to\nfeel anxious.

Meryl: As for me, I watched
Daril walk away and started
worrying about what would
happen if Trecour's navy
attacked from the
sea―something that hadn't
even happened.
Meryl: There were rumors of\nwar with the neighboring nation\nof Trecour around that time.

Meryl: If I may offer some
advice as someone who's been
there: remember that you are
not alone.

Meryl: Let us all protect the
village together while we wait
for Fidel to bring us good
news.
...You're right. Thank you, Ms.\nMeryl!

Noooooooo!!! It wasn't a tragic
past, it was just a super
embarrassing past that makes
me want to hide my face!!!
Why am I saying such pathetic\nthings!!

Read the room, you stupid
ruins!! There had to be
something else! Like a scene
where I actually look cool!!
This is just how Ted-tan\nusually is.
You're right. Ted, you're\nsurprisingly prone to worrying.
Huh?

Like the other day when Miki
got mad at you for making a
joke; you looked so depressed,
but Miki didn't really mind that
much.

You were pacing around
Miki-tan trying to apologize,
and it was actually kind of in
the way.

Ugh... I can't believe you guys
have me all figured out... And
Miki, come on, at least pretend
to care a little!
But I do understand how it\nfeels to get lost in your\nthoughts when you're alone.
When I was separated from\nLati and left all by myself...
Ah!
Lucio: Are you stupid? Writing\nletters that'll never even reach\nanyone.
Leave me alone!
Oh, look! This is Aunt Judy's\nhouse! She took care of me\nback in the past Silvarant!
The past Silvarant?

Yeah, Lati and I traveled 300
years into the past through a
Time Gate to save our
childhood friend, Dorne.
300 years ago!? Man, you guys\nreally do go on some incredible\njourneys.
Hehe! I am one of the heroes\nwho saved the universe, after\nall!

But that's not the point... this
is a memory from when I
traveled to the past and ended
up separated from everyone.
The floor is covered in letters. I\nwonder what they say.

To Lati... It's Millie. We've
always been together, so I
never thought I'd actually be
writing a letter to you...

But I don't know where to
send it, so this is the only way.
Lati, are you really here? I
don't even know how many
days it's been...
Waaaaah! Stop reading it!!

What's with the sudden panic?
Whether it's a painful past or
an embarrassing one, it's all
part of who you are, right
Millie?
No, no! Absolutely not!!

I suddenly found myself all
alone and started overthinking
everything! I wrote nothing but
the most embarrassing things!!

After that, I realized moping
around wasn't like me at all, so
I gathered up all those letters
and threw them outside!
And then...
And then?
Lati's face popped out from\nunderneath the pile of letters\nI'd thrown away.
Haha, nice timing, Lati!
It's a happy ending.
That is not a happy ending at\nall!

I was so frustrated by the
situation that I screamed, "Lati,
you idiot!" and threw the
letters everywhere, which just
drew a huge crowd!
...And Lati still won't give me\nback the letters I threw!
The words in those letters\nwere your true feelings,\nMiri-tan.

True, those letters were your
honest feelings, Millie, so it's a
good thing Lati got to hear
them.
It is NOT a good thing!! I was all alone, and the scenery outside was all snow, so I just got sentimental!

en: Come on, don't try to cover it\nup. Just be honest.
Hmph... of all people, you're the\nlast person who should be\ntelling me that, Ted.
W-what's that supposed to\nmean? "Of all people"...?
I think I'll tell Miki all about\nwhat I saw earlier when we get\nback! ♪
Hey, wait, seriously, don't! Why\nMiki?! I could handle it if you\ntold Fidel, but...!

It's no use trying to hide it.
You're so easy to read, Ted.
You're the only one who hasn't
noticed.
W-w-what do you mean,\n"obvious," Millie?!
Both Ted-tan and Miri-tan\nreally need to learn how to be\nhonest with themselves.
As <player> knows, Lymle is\nalways a good, honest girl.
Faize, you idiot!
You traitor!
Faize is the biggest idiot of\nthem all!
What's going on here?\nBadmouthing Faize to a wall?
And Sarah is joining in too...
Lymle remembers this. It was\nwhen we were heading toward\nthe idiot's planet.
...Back then, Faize followed\nKuro...
Still, what are you doing? Even\nfor vocal exercises, the\ncontent is a bit aggressive.
It was Sarah's idea. She told\nme we should shout bad things\nabout Faize together.

Sarah did? I can't imagine the
gentle Sarah suggesting
something like that... right,
Captain?
Hmph! You're doubting me!
Lymle-chan, you look like you\nhave some free time. Why don't\nyou join me in some shouting?
Shouting?
Yes! Now, let's shout together.\nOne, two... Faize-kun is, um,\nwell, a dummy!
...Sarah-tan?
Faize-kun is, um, well, a dummy.\nFaize-kun is, uh, so, a dummy\nagain!

See? I told you! This happened
before I shouted that Faize
was a dummy. My innocence
has been proven!
Sarah, why are you suddenly\ndoing this...?
Eleyna-san told me about it\nbefore.
E-tan did?

She said that if someone
speaks ill of you, you'll come
rushing back no matter how far
away you are.
No matter... how far away...
That is why, Lymle, you and I\nshould shout some mean things\nabout Faize together.
If we do that, I am sure... you\nknow?
...It is not like I actually want to\nsee Faize.
Lymle...
But I am all for badmouthing\nFaize. Sarah, you have to shout\nit with me, loud and clear!
Faize... you idiot! You're a big,\nbig, big idiot!
That is the spirit, Lymle. Now,\nlet us shout from the bottom\nof our hearts.

Oh, I see what's going on.
Sarah was just trying to cheer
Lymle up since she was
depressed that Faize was
gone.
Lymle did look pretty miserable\na moment ago.
I wasn't depressed at all! I just\nwanted to say mean things\nabout Faize!
Sure, sure. Lymle is always\nsuch an honest, good girl.
Hmph! You're doubting me\nagain!
Take this! I'm gonna get you!
Waaaaah! That's totally\ncheating!!
Being honest really is hard,\nisn't it...?
Hey, Captain, do you want to\nshout some mean things about\nEve too?
You're way too shaken up! You\nshould try being honest too,\nCaptain.

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
